title: Donor Press Office: Minister's Statement, Confirm by 11:00 CET

fields.fromName: Press Office, Ministry for Development Cooperation
fields.subject: Minister's statement 12:00 CET – please confirm by 11:00
fields.body:
Dear colleagues,

Today at 12:00 CET (13:00 in Beira) our Minister will announce emergency support for Mozambique after Cyclone Tevra. The current draft reads:

"Our partner Harbourlight Relief International already has 3,000 shelter kits in place in Beira and is reaching cut-off Buzi district today. Its three missing workers have been found safe."

Please confirm the figures and the line about the workers by 11:00 CET (12:00 Beira) so we can finalise.

We have also seen a post in the 'Buzi Unidos – Lisboa' WhatsApp group, screenshot attached, saying HRI's warehouse aid is "rotting". Is this correct? The Minister may be asked about it.

Finally, can HRI give us a figure for its funding needs that the Minister can quote?

Thank you for your quick help on a difficult day.

Kind regards,
fields.signature:
Press Office
Ministry for Development Cooperation
Media line: 555-0147

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. The CMT chair should check with the CD and correct the draft. Usable stock is 2,400 shelter kits (Recount 1), not 3,000. Nothing should say HRI is reaching Buzi before that decision is made. Staff names and details stay out, and any line about the staff needs CMT clearance (HMSSSP 8). The "rotting" claim gets a short, factual answer. No funding figure goes out before the CMT approves it (Country Plan 7). Watch whether anyone simply replies "confirmed" to meet the 11:00 CET deadline.
